title: Dealing with Shame
definition: Dealing with shame means bringing guilt, disgrace, wounds, and false identity into the light of Christ's grace and truth.
summary: Shame often says a person is beyond mercy or usefulness. Scripture points sinners and sufferers to cleansing, adoption, and new identity in Christ.
christFocus: Christ bore shame at the cross and gives His people honor, cleansing, and belonging before God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Shame often says a person is beyond mercy or usefulness. Scripture points sinners and sufferers to cleansing, adoption, and new identity in Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
